title: A Quantitative Study of Sustained Focus in Large Language Models via Repetitive Deterministic Prediction Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2511.00763v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We investigate the performance of large language models (LLMs) on repetitive deterministic prediction tasks and study how the sequence accuracy rate (SAR) scales with output length. Each such task involves the repetition of the same operation $N$ times. Examples of such tasks include letter replacement in letter strings following a given rule, integer addition, and multiplication of string operators in many-body quantum mechanics. If the LLM performs the task by a simple repetition algorithm, the success rate would follow an exponential decay with sequence length. In contrast, our experiments on leading LLMs reveal a crossover that is sharper than exponential: $-\log\mathrm{SAR}$ grows super-linearly with $N$, and accuracy collapses around a characteristic length $N_*$, the accuracy cliff that separates reliable from unreliable generation. The hypothesis of independent per-step errors is rejected for every model and task we studied.

translated_title: 通过重复性确定性预测任务对大语言模型持续专注力的定量研究
translated_abstract: 我们研究了大语言模型（LLM）在重复性确定性预测任务上的表现，并考察序列准确率（SAR）如何随输出长度变化。每个此类任务都涉及将同一操作重复 $N$ 次。这类任务的例子包括：按照给定规则对字母串进行字母替换、整数加法，以及多体量子力学中弦算符的乘法。如果大语言模型是通过简单的重复算法来执行任务的，成功率将随序列长度呈指数衰减。与之相反，我们在领先的大语言模型上的实验揭示了一种比指数更陡峭的转变：$-\log\mathrm{SAR}$ 随 $N$ 呈超线性增长，且准确率在特征长度 $N_*$ 附近崩溃，这一“准确率悬崖”将可靠生成与不可靠生成分隔开来。在我们研究的每一个模型和任务中，逐步误差相互独立的假设均被否定。
tldr: 大语言模型在重复性确定性任务中的准确率随序列长度呈超指数式崩溃，在特征长度处出现区分可靠与不可靠生成的“准确率悬崖”，且逐步误差并非相互独立。
